Error.description:
A failure, in the common error shape. The codes:
- `bad-request` (400): the body or query is not the shape the route takes, a mode is unknown, or an option is not the one the mode takes
- `unauthorized` (401): the bearer token is missing or wrong
- `not-found` (404): no look or upload of that id
- `no-route` (404): no route answers this method and path
- `too-large` (413): an upload over the ceiling, or more sources than the route takes
- `unsupported-source` (422): the mode takes no such source
- `failed` (500): a store call behind the route failed; the sentence is the store's
- `not-ready` (503): its store cannot be read, so no look can be created; `Retry-After` says when to ask again

info.description: The vision unit's server: one request and one answer shape over three modes (see, watch, read), each with its own chain of backends. A look is a question put to a set of sources; the server holds no model and no card, asks its chain over the local engine nodes and the hosted backends, and records in the look what every rung of that chain did. Bodies are JSON with camelCase keys; instants are integers of epoch milliseconds ending in `At` and spans are milliseconds ending in `Ms`. A list is a page of `items` with a `more` flag, the next page asked with the last item's `id` as `after`. Every failure is a non-2xx status in the common error shape with a `code` and an `error` sentence; the codes a route can answer stand under `x-codes`. A look that could not be answered is not a failure of the route: it is a member whose `state` is `failed` and whose `error` says why. The events the service writes stand under `x-events`.
